direction.zh-CN: 条状进度条的方向，可选 horizontal、vertical。
direction.en-US: Direction of the line progress bar: horizontal or vertical.

format.zh-CN: 格式化函数，入参为当前显示的百分比（限制在 0 到 100），返回的 JSX 渲染在环形进度条中心或条状进度条右侧；只在显示文字时执行。
format.en-US: Formatting function. It receives the shown percentage (clamped to 0-100) and returns JSX rendered in the center of a circle or on the right of a bar. It runs only when the text is shown.

indeterminate.zh-CN: 是否为不确定状态。开启后 percent 不再控制进度长度，且不展示文字，aria-valuenow 省略。
indeterminate.en-US: Whether the progress is indeterminate. When on, percent no longer controls the length, the text is hidden and aria-valuenow is omitted.

motion.zh-CN: 文字数字是否以动画过渡到新的 percent；关闭后直接跳到目标值。
motion.en-US: Whether the shown number animates to the new percent. When off it jumps to the target.

percent.zh-CN: 进度百分比；超出 0 到 100 的值会被截断。更新为 NaN 时抛出错误。
percent.en-US: Progress percentage. Values outside 0-100 are clamped. Updating it to NaN throws an error.

showInfo.zh-CN: 是否显示文字：环形显示在中间，条状显示在右侧。小号（size 为 small）的环形进度条不显示文字。
showInfo.en-US: Whether to show the text: in the center of a circle, or on the right of a bar. A small circle (size small) never shows the text.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default、small（仅 type 为 circle 时生效）、large（仅 type 为 line 时生效）。
size.en-US: Size: default, small (circle only) or large (line only).

stroke.zh-CN: 填充色。数组形式为 `{ percent, color }` 的区间列表，color 可为任意 CSS 颜色或 Semi 色板名。
stroke.en-US: Fill color. An array is a list of `{ percent, color }` intervals, where color is any CSS color or a Semi palette name.

strokeGradient.zh-CN: 是否自动生成渐变色补齐区间颜色，需要 stroke 至少设置一个颜色区间。
strokeGradient.en-US: Whether to generate gradient colors between intervals. Requires at least one interval in stroke.

strokeLinecap.zh-CN: 环形进度条端点形状，可选 round、square；条状进度条不生效。
strokeLinecap.en-US: Line cap of the circle progress bar: round or square. Has no effect on a line progress bar.

strokeWidth.en-US: Stroke width of the circle progress bar.

width.zh-CN: 环形进度条的直径；缺省时，size 为 small 取 24，否则取 72。
width.en-US: Diameter of the circle progress bar. Defaults to 24 when size is small and 72 otherwise.
